title: wolfssl: add sha3-384 and sha3-512 algorithms
description:
Add C2D_SHA3_384 and C2D_SHA3_512 to wolfssl_sha.c and wire them into all dispatch paths.

**What:** Extend wolfssl_sha.c so sha3-384 and sha3-512 are registered and functional FIPS algorithms.

**Algorithm:**
1. In wolfssl_sha.c: add `#define C2D_SHA3_384 4` and `#define C2D_SHA3_512 5` after C2D_SHA3_256=3
2. In sha_algo_name(): add cases returning "sha3-384" and "sha3-512"
3. In sha_digest_size(): add cases returning WC_SHA3_384_DIGEST_SIZE (48) and WC_SHA3_512_DIGEST_SIZE (64)
4. In sha_ctx_init() switch: add cases calling wc_InitSha3_384(&ctx->wc.sha3, NULL, INVALID_DEVID) and wc_InitSha3_512(&ctx->wc.sha3, NULL, INVALID_DEVID) — same wc_Sha3 union field, wc_Sha3 struct is shared across all SHA3 variants
5. In wolfssl_sha_sess_reset() switch: add cases calling wc_Sha3_384_Free + wc_InitSha3_384, and wc_Sha3_512_Free + wc_InitSha3_512 (same pattern as sha3-256 reset)
6. In wolfssl_sha_sess_free() switch: add cases calling wc_Sha3_384_Free(&ctx->wc.sha3) and wc_Sha3_512_Free(&ctx->wc.sha3)
7. In wolfssl_sha_update() switch: add cases calling wc_Sha3_384_Update and wc_Sha3_512_Update
8. In wolfssl_sha_finalize() switch: add cases calling wc_Sha3_384_Final and wc_Sha3_512_Final
9. Add two sess_init wrappers: wolfssl_sha3_384_sess_init and wolfssl_sha3_512_sess_init (identical pattern to wolfssl_sha3_256_sess_init)
10. Add two ops structs: wolfssl_sha3_384_ops and wolfssl_sha3_512_ops (same fields as wolfssl_sha3_256_ops, different .algo and .sess_init)
11. In wolfssl_provider.h: add extern declarations for the two new ops structs
12. In wolfssl_provider.c: add &wolfssl_sha3_384_ops and &wolfssl_sha3_512_ops to wolfssl_algo_list; increment num_algos from 22 to 24

**Defensive programming rules:**
- FIPS gate is already called by the shared update/finalize/sess_reset functions — no additional gating needed in switch cases
- wc_InitSha3_384/512 returns 0 on success, non-zero on error; check with != 0 (wolfCrypt convention)
- Pair every Init with Free in sess_reset and sess_free — including error paths in sess_init
- No enums, no flags, only #define integer constants
- The wc_Sha3 union field is shared by sha3-256/384/512 — single field, discriminated by Init function called

**Stub mode (#ifndef CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT):**
- sha_digest_size() returns hardcoded values (48 and 64) in stub path — same pattern as existing sha3-256 returns 32
- sess_init calls sha_sess_init which already has stub handling; Init/Free calls are inside #ifdef

**Agent team:** single implementer (the pattern is mechanical)
